The '''Ord Zynthar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Zynthar]].
